description: This file contains the implementation of the ParameterOptionVisitor class, which implements the OptionVisitor interface to process various search options such as limit, sort, and size for constructing a query in a model related to thing searching. It translates options into query builder modifications.

classes.name: ParameterOptionVisitor
classes.description: Implements the OptionVisitor interface to process a list of options and modify a query builder accordingly for thing search filtering.

methods.name: ParameterOptionVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a field expression factory and a query builder, ensuring neither is null.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Iterates over a list of options, invoking the accept method with this visitor on each option.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Processes a LimitOption by setting skip and limit in the query builder.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Handles a SortOption by mapping each sort entry to a SortOption and setting the sort options in the query builder.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Handles a CursorOption but performs no action as cursor processing occurs elsewhere.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Handles a SizeOption by setting the size in the query builder.

methods.name: mapSort
methods.description: Converts a SortOptionEntry to a SortOption using the property path and order.

methods.name: determineSortField
methods.description: Converts a JsonPointer key to a SortFieldExpression using the fieldExpressionFactory.

methods.name: determineSortDirection
methods.description: Converts a SortOrder enum to a SortDirection enum.
